## Summary
Bishal Budhathoki is a Sydney-based Software Engineer with a Master of Information Technology degree from CQUniversity (specializing in software engineering and mobile application development). He has demonstrated experience across the entire development lifecycle, from designing cross-platform mobile apps in Flutter and native Kotlin to building high-concurrency microservices with FastAPI, Node.js, and Google Cloud Run, alongside modern web frontends in React and Next.js.

## Core Technical Competencies
- **Mobile Engineering**: Flutter, Dart, Kotlin, Android SDK, Android Studio, iOS cross-platform deployment, Firebase Mobile Suite, state management.
- **Frontend & Web**: Next.js (App Router, Server Components, SSR/SSG), React.js, TypeScript, JavaScript (ESNext), Tailwind CSS, Responsive UI/UX, Web Performance Optimization.
- **Backend & Cloud Microservices**: Python, FastAPI, Node.js, Express, Java (Core Java, Spring concepts), RESTful APIs, GraphQL, Serverless microservices.
- **Databases & DevOps**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Firebase Firestore, Docker, Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Cloud Build), Git, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines.
- **Domain Specializations**: NDIS healthcare/care management platforms, invoice & billing engines, property/rental management, algorithmic scheduling, cybersecurity fundamentals.

## Highlighted Projects
- [CareNest](https://bishalbudhathoki.com/projects): A comprehensive care management and invoicing platform purpose-built for Australian NDIS disability support providers. Features worker shifts, client notes, timesheet tracking, automated invoice generation, and compliance audits. (Stack: Flutter, Node.js, Firebase, Google Cloud Run).
- [Hamro Ghar (Tenant-Web-App)](https://bishalbudhathoki.com/projects): Full-stack rental management web application helping property managers, tenants, and owners track lease agreements, room vacancies, and monthly payments. (Stack: React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB).
- [Invoice Generator](https://bishalbudhathoki.com/projects): Java-based enterprise desktop invoice solution with dynamic PDF creation, itemized billing, and compliant tax calculations. (Stack: Java, Swing, PDFKit).
- [Don't Fall & Chess Game](https://bishalbudhathoki.com/projects): Interactive physics and algorithm game implementations demonstrating algorithmic pathfinding, state machines, and graphics optimization. (Stack: Unity, C#, Java).
- [Automatic Timetable Generator](https://bishalbudhathoki.com/projects): International journal-published research project applying genetic algorithms and constraint satisfaction to university scheduling. (Stack: Java, Heuristic Algorithms).
